system.description:
Deal [[/r 3d6 +@battle-status.power.magic.total]]{[(SR+2)D + (Magic Power)]} magical damage to the target.

(Target: Any Bad Status): Increase the damage by +[Number of Bad Statuses x 4].

Attack magic that shoots out flaming arrows and shoots through enemies. Increases the number of arrows fired in response to a status ailment received by the opponent, burning through the enemy.
